verdict.rationale: The only automation-like feature is the built-in alert to 'get notified whenever relevant papers are published' (undermind-docs-9), which is a single fixed event-trigger, not a general rules engine where AI-native users can define custom triggers/actions. No evidence of configurable rules, webhooks, or multi-action workflows tied to arbitrary events. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger conditions, choice of actions beyond notification, API/webhook-based automation, and any documentation of a rules/automation system.
